# iNKraft

> High-quality, production-ready Kotlin projects for every platform. iNKraft is a collection of high-quality Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) libraries and plugins designed to solve the hardest parts of KMP development.

## Core Documentation

- [Home](/): The main landing page for iNKraft.
- [About](/about): Overview of iNKraft and its creator.
- [Setup](/about/setup): General setup instructions for iNKraft libraries.
- [Articles](/articles): Articles and Blog posts about Kotlin and programming in general.

## Projects

- [Cache](/projects/cache/llms.txt): High-performance, coroutine-based cache library for Kotlin Multiplatform.
- [Kotlin Native Interface](/projects/kni): Kotlin Multiplatform library designed to simplify and unify JNI development.
- [Locale](/projects/locale): A simple, serializable and modern Kotlin data class for handling locales.
- [NanoId](/projects/nanoid): Fast, secure, and URL-friendly unique ID generator.
- [Sealed](/projects/sealed): Modern KSP-based alternative to sealed-enum for Kotlin Multiplatform.
